title: Statistical Process Control Charts for Online Alignment Drift

original_idea.body:
# SPC Charts for Online Alignment Drift

**Problem:** Safety can drift gradually across alignment rounds and go unnoticed.

**Direction:** Track a safety metric across fine-tuning checkpoints, apply control-chart rules to flag drift early.

**Why it matters:** An early-warning monitor needing only a small probe set.

**Relevant context:** NeurIPS 2024 scaling laws; arXiv:2503.11701.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Early-warning drift monitor is useful but the chain to catastrophic-risk reduction is moderate.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Track a metric across checkpoints plus standard SPC rules; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused control-chart demonstration; needs a chain of fine-tune checkpoints.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models, small probe set; independent-friendly monitoring tool.

low_compute.reasoning: A chain of small fine-tune checkpoints plus inference; one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: SPC applied to alignment-training drift may be partly open though components are standard.
